title: RWA Disclosure Standard v0.1
description: Standardized disclosure for issuers of permissioned real-world assets and tokenized securities on Solana. Keyed to the token mint. Published and signed by the issuer; no registry operator asserts the contents are accurate.

assetName.description: Name of the instrument as used in the offering documents

validUntil.description: After this time the disclosure should be treated as stale

jurisdiction.description: Jurisdiction of organization, ISO 3166 plus subdivision where relevant, e.g. US-DE

registrationNumber.description: Company or registration number where one exists publicly

contact.description: A working contact address for investors

type.description: e.g. fund units, debt note, treasury-backed token, equity

offeringExemption.description: Exemptions relied upon, e.g. Reg D 506(c), Reg S

isSecurity.description: Whether the issuer treats the instrument as a security

controls.description: Powers the issuer holds over holder tokens. Required in full; this is the core of the standard.

oneOf.description: null if the extension is not enabled

canForceTransfer.description: Whether the issuer can move holder tokens without holder signature

canPause.description: Whether transfers can be globally halted

transferRestrictions.description: Identifiers from the transfer restriction schedule, e.g. US-1, US-6, US-12

enforcement.description: Recommended. How transfer restrictions are actually enforced. For MPL-3643 tokens this describes a mechanism, not a person: the freeze authority is a Token ACL MintConfig PDA delegating thaw decisions to the Gate Program, and a recovery-enabled permanent delegate is a keyless Lifecycle Manager address.

modules.description: Enabled MPL-3643 compliance modules. The module set may change before release.

gateProgram.description: Address of the gate config governing thaw decisions

claimTopics.description: Topics an eligible holder must carry, e.g. KYC, AML, residency, accreditation, sanctions screening

claimExpiry.description: How long a claim remains valid, and what happens on lapse. Vagueness here is consequential.

crankerOperator.description: Who calls freeze_permissionless on holders who fall out of compliance, and how often. Permissionless re-freeze protects no one unless someone runs it.

recoveryEnabled.description: Whether a permanent delegate exists. A mint without one cannot be clawed back, which holders should know either way.

irreversible.description: Configuration choices that cannot be undone

custodian.description: Who holds the underlying asset; "n/a" where there is none

settlementAsset.description: What redemption pays in, including mint address if on-chain

smartContractAudits.description: Security audits of any custom program. An empty array means none, and readers should treat that as a risk signal.

fees.description: Recommended, not required. Protocol fees are stated separately from the issuer's own.

protocol.description: Fees charged by the protocol, not the issuer. MPL-3643 charges in SOL per event.

borneBy.description: Who pays each protocol fee: the issuer, the holder, or a mix

riskFactors.description: Recommended. URI to the risk factor disclosure.

transferAgent.description: Recommended. Name of the transfer agent, where one is appointed.

secondaryVenues.description: Recommended. Venues where the token is expected to trade.

priorIncidents.description: Recommended. Prior freezes, forced transfers, failed redemptions, or security incidents.

heldBy.description: The human or entity controlling the key, not just the address. An address alone tells a reader nothing about who can act.

conditions.description: The stated conditions under which this power will be used
